_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN): row 34-L-fixed. No model call. A story with player.name {mode: fixed, value: 'SO-V2734 Fixed'} while SO-V2734 Wren is selected: the pane names the fixed persona and offers no Keep, requirements.missingFixedName is set and the opener stays unposted; closing the start page locks Wren and the opener STILL waits (requirements not ready); the drawer's persona-fit finding opens the start page again ([data-so=setup-fix] 'Open the start page'); creating the persona (name prefilled read-only) locks it on the server copy, the requirement clears and the opener posts exactly once (chat and server). Cleanup restores the selected persona and auto-lock and removes the SO-V2734 personas. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-34-fixed-name.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" on a no-model lane.

requires.why: scripted opener only; the persona writes need a lane

steps.eval: for (const name of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[name]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const personas = await import('/scripts/personas.js'); const pu = ctx.powerUserSettings; const record = { avatar: personas.user_avatar ?? null, autoLock: typeof pu.persona_auto_lock === 'boolean' ? pu.persona_auto_lock : null, sandboxChat: ctx.chatId ?? null }; pu.persona_auto_lock = false; const make = async (name, description) => { const result = await ctx.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/persona-create select=false name="${name}" description="${description}"`); const avatar = typeof result?.pipe === 'string' ? result.pipe.trim() : ''; if (!avatar || pu.personas?.[avatar] !== name) throw new Error(`/persona-create did not make ${name}: ${JSON.stringify(result?.pipe ?? null)}`); return avatar; }; record.wren = await make('SO-V2734 Wren', 'A quiet traveller from the hill country.'); record.tamsin = await make('SO-V2734 Tamsin', 'A cartographer who keeps late hours.'); sessionStorage.setItem('v2734-fixed', JSON.stringify(record)); await personas.setUserAvatar(record.wren, { toastPersonaNameChange: false }); if (personas.user_avatar !== record.wren) throw new Error('could not select SO-V2734 Wren as the starting persona'); const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); return record;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so the new_chat_only opener could never post`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ playerSetup: true }); const display = rt.getGlobalSettings().display; if (display.playerSetup !== true) throw new Error('display.playerSetup did not switch on'); if (display.briefing !== false) throw new Error('display.briefing is on (the runner switches it off), so this run would not measure the briefing-off start'); const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); return { playerSetup: true, briefing: false };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const OPENER = 'SO-V2734-OPENER'; const openers = () => SillyTavern.getContext().chat.filter((m) => String(m?.mes ?? '').includes(OPENER)).length; const pane = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-player-setup'); const closeModal = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-briefing-start')?.click(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const node = await until(pane, 10000, 'the start page for a fixed-name story'); const fixed = node.querySelector('[data-so="player-setup-fixed"]'); if (!fixed?.textContent?.includes('SO-V2734 Fixed')) throw new Error(`the pane does not name the fixed persona: ${fixed?.textContent ?? null}`); if (node.querySelector('[data-so="player-setup-keep"]')) throw new Error('the pane offers Keep for a persona that is not the fixed name'); if (rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.missingFixedName !== 'SO-V2734 Fixed') throw new Error(`requirements.missingFixedName: ${rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.missingFixedName}`); await sleep(3000); if (openers() !== 0) throw new Error('the opener posted before the fixed-name persona was locked'); return { fixed: fixed.textContent.trim() };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const OPENER = 'SO-V2734-OPENER'; const openers = () => SillyTavern.getContext().chat.filter((m) => String(m?.mes ?? '').includes(OPENER)).length; const pane = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-player-setup'); const closeModal = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-briefing-start')?.click(); const saved = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('v2734-fixed') ?? 'null'); if (!saved) throw new Error('the setup step did not record this run (sessionStorage v2734-fixed)'); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const start = await until(() => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-briefing-start'), 5000, 'the start button'); start.click(); await until(() => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().playerSetup?.pending === false, 15000, 'the identity step to settle'); await sleep(3000); if (openers() !== 0) throw new Error('closing the start page with another persona posted the opener; it must wait for the fixed name'); if (rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.ready !== false) throw new Error('the requirements read ready with the wrong persona locked'); return { skippedWith: (await import('/scripts/personas.js')).user_avatar };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const pane = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-player-setup'); const closeModal = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-briefing-start')?.click(); const row = await until(() => document.querySelector('[data-so="setup-row"][data-check="persona-fit"]'), 10000, 'the persona-fit finding in the drawer'); const button = row.querySelector('[data-so="setup-fix"]'); if (button?.textContent?.trim() !== 'Open the start page') throw new Error(`persona-fit offers ${JSON.stringify(button?.textContent ?? null)}`); button.click(); await until(pane, 10000, 'Open the start page to re-open the pane'); return { reopened: true };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const pane = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-player-setup'); const closeModal = () => document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open] #so-briefing-start')?.click(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const form = await until(() => pane()?.querySelector('[data-so="player-setup-create-form"]'), 5000, 'the create form (this host may lack /persona-create)'); form.open = true; const name = form.querySelector('#so-player-setup-name'); if (name.value !== 'SO-V2734 Fixed' || !name.readOnly) throw new Error(`the create name is ${JSON.stringify(name.value)} (readOnly ${name.readOnly}), expected the fixed name, read-only`); form.querySelector('[data-so="player-setup-create"]').click(); await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().playerSetup?.record?.choice === 'create' && rt.getSnapshot().playerSetup?.record?.locked === true, 20000, 'create to lock the fixed-name persona'); closeModal(); return { created: 'SO-V2734 Fixed' };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const OPENER = 'SO-V2734-OPENER'; const openers = () => SillyTavern.getContext().chat.filter((m) => String(m?.mes ?? '').includes(OPENER)).length; const serverRows = async () => { const c = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rows = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: c.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: c.chatId }), cache: 'no-cache' }).then((r) => r.json()); if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) throw new Error(`the server holds no chat file for ${c.chatId}`); return rows; }; const serverLock = async () => (await serverRows())[0]?.chat_metadata?.persona ?? null; const serverOpeners = async () => (await serverRows()).slice(1).filter((m) => String(m?.mes ?? '').includes(OPENER)).length; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const expected = Object.entries(ctx.powerUserSettings.personas ?? {}).find(([, name]) => name === 'SO-V2734 Fixed')?.[0]; if (!expected) throw new Error('no SO-V2734 Fixed persona exists'); await until(async () => (await serverLock()) === expected, 10000, 'the fixed-name persona to be locked on the server copy'); await until(() => !rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.missingFixedName, 10000, 'the fixed-name requirement to clear'); await until(async () => (await serverOpeners()) >= 1, 15000, 'the opener once the fixed name is locked'); await sleep(3000); const here = openers(); const there = await serverOpeners(); if (here !== 1 || there !== 1) throw new Error(`expected exactly one opener, the chat holds ${here} and the server copy ${there}`); return { lock: expected, openers: here };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const record = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('v2734-fixed') ?? 'null'); if (!record) return { restored: false }; const personas = await import('/scripts/personas.js'); const pu = ctx.powerUserSettings; if (record.avatar && record.avatar in (pu.personas ?? {}) && personas.user_avatar !== record.avatar) await personas.setUserAvatar(record.avatar, { toastPersonaNameChange: false }); if (record.autoLock === null) delete pu.persona_auto_lock; else pu.persona_auto_lock = record.autoLock; const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); sessionStorage.removeItem('v2734-fixed'); return { restored: true, avatar: personas.user_avatar ?? null, autoLock: pu.persona_auto_lock ?? null };
